slides.headline: 7 AI STEPS THAT FINALLY LET YOU DITCH YOUR RESUME FOR GOOD
slides.kicker: MOST PEOPLE HAVE DONE ZERO OF THESE
slides.image_prompt: Hands holding a resume-formatted page mid-flame, orange fire catching the corner from a lighter below, near-black background, a glowing electric-blue laptop screen reflecting on the dark surface behind. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, film grain. Accent: orange flame against near-black.

slides.headline: 1) DOWNLOAD CODEX AND SHIP YOUR FIRST APP
slides.body: Codex takes a plain-English description and builds a working app: front end in NextJS, database in Convex, zero code from you. Six weeks of developer work can ship tonight

slides.headline: 2) LET HERMES AGENT PLAN YOUR WHOLE STRATEGY
slides.body: Use Claude and tell it everything: your career, your goals, what you're trying to build. Then ask it: 'What workflows can you run right now to get me closer to this?'

slides.headline: 3) BUILD A MISSION CONTROL THAT RUNS YOUR LIFE
slides.body: Build automations one at a time using Hermes. Over weeks this becomes your Mission Control: a custom system that runs your operation while you sleep

slides.headline: 4) GET CLAUDE MAX AND HIT THE RATE LIMIT WEEKLY
slides.body: Get the Claude Max plan and feed it your hardest problems, not your easy questions. The people out-thinking and out-producing everyone around them right now are burning every token they pay for

slides.headline: 5) STAY ABOVE 50% ON EVERY AI PLAN YOU OWN
slides.body: Check your usage across every AI plan you pay for. If anything is below 50%, you're barely using what you have

slides.headline: 6) MASTER CLAUDE CODE AND CODEX SIDE BY SIDE
slides.body: Claude Code for planning: describe what you're building and it maps the whole architecture. Codex for execution: hand it a task and it writes the code

slides.headline: 7) BUILD YOUR PLATFORM. RESUMES DON'T MATTER ANYMORE.
slides.body: Companies have mostly stopped reading resumes. They check your platform: what you build in public, who follows you, what you talk about

slides.headline: SAVE THIS
slides.body: You'll want these when you start. Save this post. Daily AI news and real skills, that's all we post

caption:
Swipe through all 7. Most people have done zero of these steps and it's going to cost them. 🧩

Download Codex and build your first app in plain English, use Hermes agent to reverse-prompt your whole strategy, build a Mission Control that automates your daily tasks, get Claude Max and hit its rate limit every week, stay above 50 percent usage on every AI plan you own, master Claude Code and Codex side by side, and start building a platform because resumes don't get read anymore.

Every white-collar job now has a version of itself that can be done faster by someone using these seven steps. Most people haven't started any of them. The window is still open.
